elements.text:
Luster Tool creates a tool out of pure sunlight.

  On cast, a swirl rises through you and gathers into a knot above your head. It takes about four seconds. When the sound finishes on its chime, the light sets and the tool is yours.

  Which tool you get is random: a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel or hoe of light. You cannot choose.

  It costs 30 mana and needs spell charge level 4.
